title: Gate row, version 2
description: WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: one row of gates_report.json.gates.<id> (and gates_rows/<id>.json) as written by aid-run-gates.sh since P097 Step 2. The row is the contract with every reader; scripts/lib/aid-gate-row.sh (gate_row_normalize) maps a version-1 row onto this shape and reads the closed reason vocabulary from `properties.reason.pattern` here. `result` is the version-1 compatibility field, derived from status/waived, kept for one release.

reason.description: Closed vocabulary. exit_<n>: the command's exit code (exit_0 with status pass; a status skip with exit_2 is the pass_criteria 'exit 2' convention). job_timeout/job_lost/job_cancelled: the background job's terminal state. not_in_profile, missing_script, vacuous_pass, reused_from, legacy_row: plan P097 Data Model. The remaining names are the runner's pre-existing did-not-run reasons (aid-run-gates.sh), kept under their existing names because the summary and eight suites already render and assert them.

evidence.description: Log path relative to the run's evidence directory (a background job's stdout.log); null when the gate ran in the foreground, whose output is on the row itself.

waived.description: A PM waiver on a fail row. Never a reason and never a status.
